newsitem.title: USA: Capstar Hotel to acquire Virginia hotel.
newsitem.headline: Capstar Hotel to acquire Virginia hotel.

text.p: Capstar Hotel Co on Tuesday said it would acquire the Washington National Airport Hilton in Crystal City, Virginia, from U.S. Hotel Associates Inc.

Capstar, a Washington-based hotel management and investment concern, did not disclose the purchase price, but officials said in a press release that the company planned to invest $4 million to renovate the hotel.

Upon the completion of the purchase, which is expected within 30 days, the company will have tripled the number of hotels it owns in less than one year. Its portfolio currently consists of 61 properties, with three more under purchase contract.

"We currently have substantial funds available through our line of credit for additional acquisitions. ...We remain aggressive acquirers of hotels, primarily in urban and resort locations," Paul Whetsell, CapStar chief executive and president, said.
